## Review checklist

- [ ] I followed the standard article sequence or explained why it does not apply.
- [ ] Mathematical examples and interactive outputs have been checked.
- [ ] Links, aliases, related entries, and source IDs resolve.
- [ ] Historical claims are specific, sourced, and do not use nuance as exoneration.
- [ ] Content is readable with JavaScript disabled and usable by keyboard.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build`.
- [ ] I agree to MIT for code and CC BY 4.0 for contributed editorial content.
